title: clematis integrifolia subsp. ovata
intro: Clematis integrifolia subsp. ovata, commonly known as Mountain Clematis, is a perennial flowering plant native to mountainous regions. The plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce pain, and alleviate inflammation, making it a popular remedy for stress, anxiety, and muscle cramps. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Clematis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in natural medicine.
